title: Bride
& Groom
meet.note: From a chance meeting at a friend’s rooftop Diwali party to a lifetime of festivals together. We are so happy to be starting this new chapter in the pink city, surrounded by the people who made us who we are. Thank you for every blessing, every phone call and every bit of love. We cannot wait to dance with you.
